name: Nadia P.
text: The coconut milk scrub is unbelievably soft on the skin, and it actually smells like coconut, not perfume.

name: Thabo M.
text: Ordered the coffee scrub for my feet after a long week standing at work. Genuinely helped, and delivery was quick.

name: Aisha K.
text: Lovely texture and the charcoal scrub really does feel deep-cleaning. Would love an unscented option too.
